title: Account
signInDescription: Better Notepad uses the private app data folder of your Google Drive. It cannot see anything else in your Drive.
signInHint: A browser window opens for the Google consent screen.
clientIdHint: Google sign-in is not configured in this build. Install a build that includes the publisher's OAuth client.
signOutMessage: Choose what happens to the local copy of your notes.
removeLocalWarning: Local notes are deleted. They remain in your Drive app data folder and return after signing in again.
scopeNotice: Only the hidden app data folder is accessed. Nothing is shared.
